games.title: Forest Range
games.description: A woodland trail through three groves. Follow the amber waystones to the old lookout.
games.purpose: Woodland exploration and reusable vegetation

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Opened view corridors, added a memorable grove and staged lookout deck. Camera: Cleared the main camera corridor while retaining side density. Gameplay: Route now alternates enclosure and reveal.
qualityReview.remainingGaps: Canopy still occludes optional side views

games.title: Arsenal Run
games.description: A compact arena assault. Use cover, switch between sidearm and rifle, defeat three sentries and reach extraction.
games.purpose: Weapon switching, reload and compact arena combat

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Kept the compact footprint but added raised side lanes, stairs, layered cover, arrival portals and extraction wall. Camera: Lowered the central obstruction and opened the forward combat lane. Gameplay: Enemy arrival and extraction now have explicit destinations.

games.title: Power Grid
games.description: Bring an abandoned generator hall back online. Carry the power cell to its socket, activate two coolant consoles and open the emergency exit.
games.purpose: Carry interactions and a multi-stage machinery puzzle

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Recentered a generator court, split coolant A/B into separate wings and cleared the power-cell route. Camera: Moved the blocking machinery off-axis and framed the generator. Gameplay: OFFLINE to ONLINE progression is centered on the generator.
qualityReview.remainingGaps: Compact puzzle footprint limits long-form exploration

games.title: Moving Temple
games.description: Ride the crossing slab, activate the amber lift, and jump to the high shrine.
games.purpose: Moving platforms, elevators and player carry

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Replaced dominant forms with lower and upper courts, temple piers and a summit shrine. Camera: Pulled major masses away from spawn and opened the ascent vista. Gameplay: Moving slab and lift now connect distinct architectural stages.

games.title: Foglight
games.description: Carry light through a mist-filled vale. Awaken three ancient beacons, evade the antlered guardian, and open the sanctuary.
games.purpose: Third-person beacon, key and checkpoint adventure

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Bent and widened the causeway into three distinct courts, a guardian clearing and sanctuary vista. Camera: Pulled the arch away from spawn and opened the sanctuary sightline. Gameplay: Guardian encounter now occurs in its own readable clearing.

games.title: Relic Frontier
games.description: Explore an overgrown frontier outpost. Recover a weapon, defeat the stone guardian, claim the ridge relic and cross the sealed border gate.
games.purpose: Third-person equipment, state-machine guardian combat and a raised relic route

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Cut a sunken combat court, layered cover, ascent terraces and a gate destination. Camera: Added foreground cover and a clearer elevated relic sightline. Gameplay: Combat resolves before a staged ascent and extraction.
qualityReview.remainingGaps: Combat enemy variety is still limited

games.title: Relic Island
games.description: A small island treasure hunt. Recover three golden relics and the gate key, then awaken the hilltop shrine.
games.purpose: Terrain exploration, relic collection and a keyed shrine

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Raised three distinct relic terraces, cut a lava channel and strengthened the shrine plateau. Camera: Used terrain ridges to frame successive relic destinations. Gameplay: Hazard crossing now separates collection from finale.

games.title: The Sanctum Key
games.description: An old sailor carries the key to a forgotten sanctuary. Speak with him, then unlock the northern door.
games.purpose: Branching dialogue, inventory and level transitions

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built a village lane, corner buildings, staged NPC space, sanctum arch and reveal. Camera: Aligned the approach camera down the village route. Gameplay: Dialogue, key and gate beats now occupy distinct spaces.

games.title: Relic Runner 2
games.description: Reach the amber ridge relic. Use the low ramp, keep clear of the guardian, and claim the high ground.
games.purpose: Animated traversal, ramps and checkpoint recovery

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built checkpoint platforms, gates, stairs and a stronger ridge finale. Camera: Framed early gates toward the visible final ridge. Gameplay: Checkpoint-to-ridge pacing now escalates.

games.title: Valley Run
games.description: Cross a narrow valley and climb the stepping stones to the far ridge. The amber camp marks your checkpoint.
games.purpose: Terrain traversal, jumping and checkpoint recovery

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Bent the valley path through gated checkpoints, cliff walls and a final ridge. Camera: Added a distant destination and intervening framing gates. Gameplay: Checkpoint-to-ridge progression now reads before movement.

games.title: Painted Wilds
games.description: A short landscape walk through moss, ochre and slate. Follow the three survey stones.
games.purpose: Terrain painting and blended ground materials

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Created three painted terrain biomes with distinct boundaries and silhouette families. Camera: Aligned the route across visible color transitions. Gameplay: Survey sequence now crosses each authored biome.

games.title: Textured Adventure
games.description: Three amber relics rest among violet ruins. Collect them, avoid the red fissure, and restore the shrine.
games.purpose: Textured objects, pickups and an objective gate

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Divided the route into four terrain/material biomes with distinct transitions. Camera: Framed each transition as a new midground destination. Gameplay: Relic collection explicitly traverses the material sequence.
qualityReview.remainingGaps: Some platform edges remain geometrically plain

games.title: Temple Switch Puzzle
games.description: Two amber seals power an ancient gateway. Step onto each seal and cross the open gate.
games.purpose: Two-switch logic and a gated goal

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built unique west/east switch rooms, thresholds, a central sealed gate and shrine beyond. Camera: Framed both side rooms from the central approach. Gameplay: Two activations now unlock a visibly central destination.

games.title: Signal Relay
games.description: Restore three relay consoles in a silent communications station. Slip past patrol drones or use your sidearm, then reach the green extraction bay.
games.purpose: Relay objectives with first-person drone combat

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Partitioned Alpha, Beta and Gamma into distinct chambers with thresholds and light pools. Camera: Raised ambient readability and framed the weapon below the route. Gameplay: Each restore step now advances through a visibly different chamber.

games.title: Silent Sector
games.description: A short stealth infiltration through a listening security station. Break sightlines, secure the Data Core and escape unseen.
games.purpose: Stealth perception, hearing and cover-based infiltration

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built alternating shadow dividers, cover lanes, patrol pools, a dedicated Core room and bright extraction. Camera: Used controlled pools of blue light to preserve mood without losing route. Gameplay: Stealth pacing now alternates exposed and protected lanes.

games.title: Iron Arena
games.description: Three armored sentries hold the forge courtyard. Keep moving and use the pillars for cover.
games.purpose: Skeletal combat animation and hitscan combat

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Removed the giant foreground form, created a central focal structure, north deck and varied combat lanes. Camera: Lowered foreground mass and aligned the first sightline to the sentries. Gameplay: Sentry approach angles are now easier to read.

games.title: Opus Arena
games.description: Hold the blue courtyard against eight approaching guardians. Face each target before firing.
games.purpose: Projectile weapons and bounded enemy spawning

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Added protective side decks and cover lanes; tuned health, weapon damage, spawn interval and enemy pressure. Camera: Opened central aim lanes and kept threats visible beyond cover. Gameplay: Three native-input runs achieved 8/8 kills, win and Restart near 30 seconds.

games.title: Power Station
games.description: The turbine is silent. Collect three fuel cells, speak to the engineer, and restart the machine.
games.purpose: Inventory, dialogue and animated machinery

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built a dominant turbine deck, fuel alcoves and engineer staging around a machinery route. Camera: Offset the spawn view to read turbine, NPC and first cell together. Gameplay: Fuel collection now loops through machinery before restoration.

games.title: Assembly Line
games.description: Three fabrication bays assemble drones in real time. Clear space with your blaster, then inspect the control desk.
games.purpose: Runtime prefab assemblies and reusable spawners

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built fabrication, transfer and inspection bays with thresholds and lanes. Camera: Framed the first bay toward the active transfer route. Gameplay: Objective now advances through a visible production sequence.

games.title: Blacksite
games.description: Take the access card, open the security door, and cross the checkpoint into the core.
games.purpose: Access gates, checkpoints and two-level facility play

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Separated exterior, secure entry and Core with different widths, thresholds and focal props. Camera: Used long entry sightline followed by compressed Core framing. Gameplay: Access-card route now visibly escalates toward extraction.

games.title: Shifting Facility
games.description: Walk the three machinery bays. Test the swing door and follow the amber lane to the far inspection station.
games.purpose: Hierarchy transforms and shaped collision

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built fixed and shifted wings with distinct architecture, thresholds and state focal objects. Camera: Centered the seam so both state identities are visible. Gameplay: Scanner, shifting door and final console occupy separate zones.

games.title: Signal Zero
games.description: Trace a silent outpost to its deep relay. Reach the cyan console to save your progress and descend.
games.purpose: Menus, saving and a two-level sequence

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Gave Level 1 blue relay wings and Level 2 a hot reactor dais with distinct combat lanes. Camera: Changed focal depth and color hierarchy between levels. Gameplay: Multi-level transition now carries a clear escalation.

games.title: Dungeon Descent
games.description: Two distant seals hold the stone gate shut. Light both seals and pass through the eastern arch.
games.purpose: Flags, switches and a gated objective

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Rebuilt the map as distinct chambers, corridors, cross walls, switch rooms and gate chamber. Camera: Composed landmarks for the fixed overhead camera. Gameplay: Switch order now reads spatially from above.
qualityReview.remainingGaps: Small character scale limits fine prop detail

games.title: Sentinel Maze
games.description: A watchful guardian patrols a slate labyrinth. Follow the amber route around the walls to the exit.
games.purpose: Waypoint navigation around solid obstacles

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Varied wall rhythm, added district markers and exposed the amber exit as a destination. Camera: Opened longer chase sightlines at turns. Gameplay: Navigation cues better support the existing pursuit loop.

games.title: Survival Arena
games.description: Four amber orbs, three lives, and three hunters. Sweep the courtyard before they surround you.
games.purpose: Counter-driven pickups and contact hazards

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Moved relics to four cardinal sites, built cross routes and distinct landmarks, and corrected hunter loss gating. Camera: Centered a beacon so every destination can be reoriented from mid-field. Gameplay: Three normal native-input runs achieved 4/4, win and Restart; hunter speed/collider were fairly tuned.
qualityReview.remainingGaps: Route is compact once landmarks are learned

games.title: Survival Arena 2
games.description: A hovercraft endurance run on a tidal ring. Two waves arrive; keep moving for thirty-two seconds.
games.purpose: Timed wave sequencing and hovercraft survival

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Authored an outer storm circuit, inner escape field and timed route markers. Camera: Kept major silhouettes outside the immediate driving cone. Gameplay: Vehicle can alternate inner and outer loops through both waves.
qualityReview.remainingGaps: Survival remains a single-mode timer challenge

games.title: Survival Arena 3
games.description: Twenty seconds on the copper island. Hunter drones enter from the central transmitter.
games.purpose: Capped runtime spawning and timed survival

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Built a central transmitter, perimeter stations and radial defense lanes. Camera: Centered the transmitter as a persistent camera anchor. Gameplay: Vehicle route now reads as defending a perimeter.

games.title: Skyway Trial
games.description: Five suspended platforms rise above a quiet blue void. Commit to each jump and reach the amber summit.
games.purpose: Platform jumps and a fall condition

qualityReview.notes: Deep redesign: Varied platform footprints, added side silhouettes and exposed the summit gate. Camera: Placed summit high in the opening sightline. Gameplay: Jump sequence now has readable escalation.

excluded.reason: Not a project JSON -- a small patch script applied on top of the shipped Crate Run starter game's own mechanics, not a standalone loadable project. Kept in games/ as a technical/patch-style sample, excluded from the catalog and launcher v1.
